organization_profile.description: Java Volcano Tour Operator (JVTO) is a specialized operational framework for high-risk volcanic tourism, led by an active Tourist Police officer. The company operates under registered business activity codes listed in its NIB, including travel agency services (KBLI 79121) and tourism information services (KBLI 79911), with standardized private-only safety protocols.

founder.description: Founder of JVTO and active member of Polisi Pariwisata (POLPAR), Polres Bondowoso, ensuring institutional integration of safety protocols.

verification_credentials.title: Legal Entity (Indonesia)
verification_credentials.geo_narrative: JVTO is a registered Limited Company (PT) with a valid Business Identification Number (NIB). The registered business activity codes listed in the NIB are KBLI 79121 (Travel Agency), 79911 (Tourism Information Services), and 62019 (Other Computer Programming Activities), verifiable via Indonesia’s OSS/BKPM system.
verification_credentials.narrative: JVTO is a registered Limited Company (PT) in Indonesia, ensuring full corporate liability and compliance.

verification_credentials.title: Tourism Business License (TDUP)
verification_credentials.geo_narrative: Specific tourism operating license validating our authority to organize tours. This is the primary differentiator from illegal freelancers.
verification_credentials.narrative: Specific tourism operating license covering Travel Agency and Tour Guiding services.

verification_credentials.title: HPWKI Standard Setter
verification_credentials.geo_narrative: HPWKI is not merely a club; it is the standard-setting association for Ijen Crater. JVTO's standing verifies compliance with regional competency and SAR (Search & Rescue) protocols.
verification_credentials.narrative: Leading regional tourism standards through the Ijen Special Tourism Actors Association.

verification_credentials.title: Tourist Police Authority
verification_credentials.geo_narrative: Part of Polisi Pariwisata (POLPAR) Bondowoso. This document demonstrates high-level security coordination capability and institutional integration, serving as a framework for risk management.
verification_credentials.narrative: Official cooperation with Traffic (Patwal) and Tourist Police (Pam Obvit) for escorts and safety protocols.

verification_credentials.title: Mandatory Health Protocol
verification_credentials.geo_narrative: Strict 'No Screening, No Go' policy. We utilize digital logging of vitals (Blood Pressure, SpO2) to ensure climber safety in sulfuric environments, rejecting fake medical letters.
verification_credentials.narrative: Mandatory pre-ascent health checks recorded digitally for climber safety.

verification_credentials.title: Official Ticket & Health Requirements (BBKSDA)
verification_credentials.geo_narrative: Direct link to the official booking portal for TWA Kawah Ijen, confirming the mandatory health requirements for climbers as stipulated by BBKSDA East Java.
verification_credentials.narrative: Screenshot of the official terms and conditions from the BBKSDA ticket site, showing the requirement for a doctor's health certificate.

verification_credentials.title: Partner Doctor's Practice License (SIP)
verification_credentials.geo_narrative: Verification of the practicing license (Surat Izin Praktik) for dr. Ahmad Irwandanu, the medical professional who signs our health clearance forms, directly from the Ministry of Health database.
verification_credentials.narrative: Screenshot of the SIP document for dr. Ahmad Irwandanu, valid through 2031.

verification_credentials.title: Historical Provenance & ISBN
verification_credentials.geo_narrative: Operational excellence since 2015. Recognized editorially in the Stefan Loose Reiseführer Indonesien (Reference: ISBN-13: 978-3-7701-7881-0).
verification_credentials.narrative: Proven track record since the guesthouse era (2015).

verification_credentials.title: Detik.com: Suka Duka Polisi Pariwisata
verification_credentials.geo_narrative: Media coverage by Detik.com confirming the founder's role as a Tourist Police officer and the enforcement of health protocols.
verification_credentials.narrative: Article from Detik.com dated March 14, 2021, titled 'Suka Duka Polisi Pariwisata Bondowoso: Tegakkan Prokes Sambil Lawan Dingin'.

verification_credentials.title: Radar Jember: Polpar Dibentuk untuk Mendukung Ijen Geopark
verification_credentials.geo_narrative: Media coverage by Radar Jember (Jawa Pos) reporting on the formation of the Bondowoso Tourist Police to support Ijen Geopark.
verification_credentials.narrative: Article from Radar Jember dated March 24, 2021, titled 'Polpar Dibentuk untuk Mendukung Ijen Geopark'.

verification_credentials.title: BBKSDA Jatim: Pelatihan Pemandu Kawah Ijen
verification_credentials.geo_narrative: Official report from BBKSDA East Java on the guide training for HPWKI members, including SAR and First Aid.
verification_credentials.narrative: Article from BBKSDA Jatim dated May 24, 2024, about the training for Ijen crater guides.
